AboutUpdate1Title: Encrypted Portable ZIP Backup & Cross-PC Restore
AboutUpdate1Desc: Atomic SQLite snapshot, encrypted vault, and branding packaged into an AES-256 ZIP with optional custom password, SHA-256 verification, and automatic path re-binding on any PC.
AboutUpdate2Title: PBKDF2 Hashing, Sole-Admin Guard & SHA-256 Check
AboutUpdate2Desc: Files are stored encrypted (.denc) with live SHA-256 verification on preview, PBKDF2-SHA256 password hashing, sole-admin lockout protection, and a complete Security Audit Log.
AboutUpdate3Title: Bidirectional Linking + Thermal Barcode / QR Stickers
AboutUpdate3Desc: Two-way linking between Inbound and Outbound records with one-click navigation, plus automatic QR/Barcode stamps supporting Thermal Label Printers (50×30mm & 80×50mm) and A4.
AboutUpdate4Title: Browse All Attachments, Rotate & Permission-Guarded Export
AboutUpdate4Desc: Navigate all transaction attachments inside the viewer with 90° rotation, zoom, permission-checked printing/exporting, and drag-and-drop support for files and entire folders.
AboutUpdate5Title: Merge Duplicate Entities & Safe Dossier Transfer
AboutUpdate5Desc: Merge duplicate entities, automatically cascade entity renames across records, and safely transfer documents to another dossier (or export unencrypted backup) before deleting a dossier.
AboutUpdate6Title: Custom Organization Branding, Direct PDF & Safe CSV
AboutUpdate6Desc: Customize organization name and logo in report headers, filter reports by dossier or keyword, export directly to high-DPI PDF without a printer, and export formula-safe Excel CSV.
AboutUpdate7Title: Follow-Up Alerts, Context Menu & Recycle Bin
AboutUpdate7Desc: Smart alerts for due/overdue follow-up transactions, right-click context menu to mark records as Completed in one click, and a full Recycle Bin with restore and empty options.
AboutUpdate8Desc: Composite SQLite indexes for instant search across large archives with Arabic text normalization, global keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+N, Ctrl+Shift+N, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+P, F5), and Dark/Light themes.
